# Hybrid Vector Stores

[⬅ Back to the full list](../README.md) · 1 item · [Browse on the website](https://vectordb.ever.works)

- [Redis Vector Search](https://redis.io/search/) - Redis Vector Search (part of Redis Stack) enables vector similarity search on Redis with HNSW indexing, hybrid BM25+vector, and metadata filtering. It leverages Redis caching for low-latency real-time apps like semantic search. Vs dedicated DBs like Pinecone, Redis offers multi-model (JSON/KV + vectors) but requires more config for scale.
